chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Taliqani (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Amer said: He narrated to me Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Qat’i said: He narrated to us Al-Hasan ibn Ali an-Nakhhas al-Adl said: He narrated to us Al-Hasan ibn Abd al-Wahid al-Khazzaz said: He narrated to us Ali ibn Ja'far ibn Umar said: He narrated to me Umar ibn Waqid said: As-Sandi ibn Shahak sent for me one night while I was in Baghdad, summoning me, and I feared that this was for some ill he intended for me,

He said: So I gave instructions to my family regarding what I would need, and said, 'Indeed, to God we belong and to Him we shall return.' Then I mounted and went to him. When he saw me approaching, he said, 'O Abu Hafs, perhaps we frightened and alarmed you?' I said, 'Yes.' He said, 'There is nothing but good there.' I said, 'Then send a messenger to my house to inform them of my news.' He said, 'Yes.' Then he said, 'O Abu Hafs, do you know why I sent for you?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Do you know Musa ibn Ja'far?' I said, 'Yes, by God, I know him, and there has been friendship between me and him for a long time.'

He said, 'Who is here in Baghdad who knows him and whose word is accepted?' So I named some men for him. It occurred to me that he (peace be upon him) had died. He said: So he sent for them and they came as I had come. He said to them, 'Do you know any men who know Musa ibn Ja'far?' So they named some men for him and he sent for them. By morning, we were in the house, more than fifty men who knew Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) and had been in his company.

He said: Then he stood up and went inside, and we prayed. Then his secretary came out with a scroll and wrote down our names, our residences, our occupations, and our characteristics. Then he went in to As-Sandi. He said: So As-Sandi came out and gestured to me with his hand, and said to me, 'Stand up, O Abu Hafs.' So I stood up and our companions stood up, and we entered. He said to me, 'O Abu Hafs, uncover the cloth from the face of Musa ibn Ja'far.' So I uncovered it and saw that he was dead, so I wept and said the prayer of return.

Then he said to the men, 'Look at him.' So one by one they approached and looked at him. Then he said, 'Do you all testify that this is Musa ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad?' I said: We said, 'Yes, we testify that he is Musa ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them.' Then he said, 'O boy, throw a handkerchief over his private parts and uncover the rest.' He said: So he did. He said, 'Do you see in him any sign that you would doubt?' We said, 'No, we see nothing in him except that he is dead.'

He said: 'Do not leave until you wash him, shroud him (and bury him).' He said: So we did not leave until he was washed, shrouded, and carried (to the place of prayer). Then As-Sandi ibn Shahak prayed over him, and we buried him and returned. And Umar ibn Waqid used to say, 'No one is more knowledgeable about Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) than me. How can they say that he is alive while I myself buried him?'

key_terms.الاسترجاع: Saying 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi rajioon' upon hearing news of death
key_terms.السَّنْدِيُّ بْنُ شاهَكَ: As-Sandi ibn Shahak, the official who summoned the witnesses
key_terms.مُوسَىٰ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ: Musa ibn Ja'far, the Imam whose death is being verified

ai.seo_question: What evidence was used to confirm the death of Musa ibn Ja'far in this narration?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *‘Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* provides a detailed account of the death of Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) in Baghdad, emphasizing the verification process by As-Sandi ibn Shahak to confirm the Imam's identity and natural passing. The story highlights the tension between the Imam's public status and the reality of his death, serving as a key reference in Shia scholarship regarding the timeline and circumstances of his burial before his eventual return or the recognition of his lineage. Umar ibn Waqid’s concluding remark underscores his personal certainty in the face of those who might have doubted the Imam's mortality.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 8-3 Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Taliqani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Amer quoted on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Muhammad al-Qat’aye, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Ali an-Nakhkhas al-Adl, on the authority of Al-Hassanibn Abdul Wahid al-Khazzaz, on the authority of Ali ibn Ja’far ibn Umar, on the authority of Umar ibn Vaqid, on the authority of Umar ibn Waqid, “One night I was in Baghdad when As-Sandi ibn Shahak sent someone after me. I feared that he might have some bad intentions regarding me.

I gave the necessary instructions to my wife and said, ‘From God we are, and unto Him is our return.’ Then I went to see him. When As-Sandi ibn Shahak saw me, he said, ‘O Aba Hafs (Umar ibn Waqid)! It seems that I have scared you.’ I said, ’Yes. You did.’ He said, ‘I have called you in for a good reason.’ I said, ’Then send someone to my house to inform them so that they no longer worry.’ He said, ’Fine.’ Then As-Sindi ibn Shahak added, ’O Aba Hafs! Do you know why I sent for you?’ I said, ‘No.’ He said, ’Do you know Musa ibn Ja’far?’ I said, ’By God, yes I do. I have known him for a long time and we are friends.’

He said, ‘Who do you know in Baghdad who knows him and whose words the people would accept?’ I mentioned some names. I thought that he (s) had died. As-Sandi called them in and asked them, ‘Do you know anyone who knows Musa ibn Ja’far (s)?’ They mentioned a few names. He called them in too. By the time of the morning more than fifty people who knew Musa ibn Ja’far (s) and had been in his company for sometime were called in.”

The narrator added, “Then As-Sindi stood up and went to the other room. We said our prayers. Then his secretary came in with a list in which he recorded our names, our addresses, our jobs and our characteristics. Then he returned to As-Sandi. Then As-Sandi came out of the room and pointed at me with his finger and said, “O Aba Hafs! Stand up.” I stood up. So did the rest. We all went into the room. He told me, “O Aba Hafs! Remove the cover from Musa ibn Ja’far’s face.” I removed the cover and saw that he had died. Then I cried and said, “From God we are, and unto Him is our return!”

Then As-Sandi said, “All of you look!” They moved ahead one by one and looked. Then he asked us, “Will you all testify that he is Musa ibn Ja’far (s)?” He then told his servant, “Throw a handkerchief over his penis and remove the whole cover.” The servant did that. As-Sandi said, “Do you see any injuries or signs of being choked on his body?” We all said, “No. We do not see anything on him. We see that he has died naturally.”

He said, “Do not leave here until you perform the major ritual ablutions for the dead, shroud him (and bury him).”The narrator added, “We did not leave there until we performed the ritual ablutions, shrouded him, and carried him (to the place for praying). Then As-Sindi ibn Shahak said the prayers for him. Then we buried him and returned.”Umar ibn Waqid constantly said, “No one is more knowledgeable than me about Musa ibn Ja’far. How can they claim that he is alive while I myself was present when we buried him?”
